id: title:arnohillen:log surfacing scoring tick counts in the message

review.posthog_relevance: Supports debugging and observability of the session replay scoring workflow, ensuring diagnostic information is not lost when switching from ignored structured logging parameters to message-based logging.
review.reason: The change replaces an ignored structured logging parameter (`extra=`) with message-based logging, preserving diagnostic information for session replay scoring and chunk failures. This is a localized maintenance and reliability improvement. Tests are updated to match. No broader systemic capability or unverified benefit is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the previous logging configuration caused silent drops or was merely deprecated; the change does not independently prove a production incident or broader systemic risk reduction.

observations.limitations: This chunk only shows a change to the implementation and tests of the session replay scoring workflow. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced structured logging with message-based logging. P1.F1.H1: The workflow no longer uses the `extra=` parameter, which is ignored by the current logger, and instead formats the estimated unscored sessions into the message string. P1.F1.H2: The workflow no longer uses the `extra=` parameter for chunk failures and tick summaries, formatting the relevant metrics into the message.
observations.posthog_connection: This workflow is responsible for scoring and surfacing session replay sessions. The change ensures that diagnostic information about unscored and failed chunks is still emitted, but the delivery mechanism is fixed to avoid silent drops.
